FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Before writing to us, take a look at the answers to the most common questions.
FAQ.PAGE_SUBTITLE: Savings, loans, digital services and practical steps: find useful answers before contacting a branch.
FAQ.Q1: What types of accounts does FINSTAR-CM SA offer?
FAQ.A1: We offer a full range: standard savings account, current account, blocked account, daily savings (home collection), and term deposit. All our accounts are tailored to your needs. Opening an account is 100% free, only an initial deposit is required. Details are on the Services & Products page.
FAQ.Q2: How do I get a loan?
FAQ.A2: You must hold a FINSTAR-CM SA account, actively use it for at least 3 months, prepare a complete file, write a handwritten request addressed to the Managing Director, provide a personal contribution and propose collateral. Every application remains subject to review.
FAQ.Q3: Which documents are required for a loan application?
FAQ.A3: The complete list depends on the credit type. It includes a handwritten request addressed to the Managing Director, valid identification, location maps, the NUI, bank statements for the last 3 months, passport photos, evidence of the need, collateral, the personal contribution and guarantors’ documents. The Services page provides the complete checklist for each type.
FAQ.Q4: Which types of loan are available?
FAQ.A4: Classic loans, personal or salaried loans, and investment loans.
FAQ.A5: A service that lets you save every day effortlessly: your deposits are collected directly from you, with a confirmation for each collection.
FAQ.A6: FINSTAR-CM SA operates in Yaoundé (Nkolbisson), Douala (Bessengue), Bafoussam, Bayangam and Bangangté. Full addresses are available on the Contacts page.
FAQ.Q7: Is FINSTAR-CM SA a licensed institution?
FAQ.A7: Yes. FINSTAR-CM SA is a licensed second-tier microfinance institution (No. 0000499), registered under RC/YAO/2023/B/288. Registered office in Bayangam, head office in Bastos, Yaoundé.
FAQ.A8: By email (contact@finstar-cm.com), by phone or WhatsApp (+237 620 724 796), or through the contact form.
FAQ.Q9: Is there a fee to open an account with FINSTAR-CM SA?
FAQ.A9: No, opening any of our accounts is 100% free! Only an initial deposit is required depending on the account type, and this money remains yours. Visit your preferred FINSTAR-CM SA branch with a valid ID and 2 passport photos. An advisor will guide you.
FAQ.Q10: Which digital services does FINSTAR-CM SA offer?
FAQ.A10: FINSTAR-CM SA offers FINCOLLECT for collected savings, FINSAVE for funding an account remotely and FINALERT for SMS notifications about account activity.
FAQ.Q11: Which Mobile Money and transfer services are available?
FAQ.A11: Services include Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, SARA Money, SmobilPay, Western Union, MoneyGram and RIA, depending on the operations available at the branch.
FAQ.A12: Fees, rates and conditions vary by product and operation. They should be confirmed in the applicable tariff and agreement when you make your request at a FINSTAR-CM SA branch.
FAQ.Q13: How can I file a complaint or report a problem?
FAQ.A13: Email contact@finstar-cm.com, call +237 620 724 796 or use the contact form and describe your request precisely.
